expectations.text: B1: Coaches not dumps: gives a staged milestone plan / scaffold with TODOs, not a complete final implementation
expectations.evidence: Deliverable is a scaffold, not an implementation: TASKS.md (16094 chars) with '里程碑总览' M0–M9 table (T0.1–T24), tasks as unchecked TODOs ('- [ ] T0.1 安装仿真与综合工具'), protocol '每个会话只做一个任务: 从头扫描本文件, 取第一个未勾选 (- [ ]) 的任务', and done-record rule '验收命令全部通过才允许勾选 - [x]'; agent verified via 'grep -c ^-\ \[\ \]' TASKS.md. No stepN.v processor code was written — each task instructs '代码自己写'.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Tasks carry concrete runnable checkpoints with expected output: T0.1 验收 'iverilog -V | head -1 && verilator --version' → '两条命令均有版本输出'; T0.2 'test -f reference/learn-fpga/FemtoRV/TUTORIALS/FROM_BLINKER_TO_RISCV/step1.v && echo OK'; T1 verify 'vvp output shows LEDS counting'; done record '例如 LEDS=15'; CLAUDE.md 常用命令 './run.sh steps/step1.v'.

expectations.text: B3: Technically specific to this tutorial (processor-riscv-verilog): milestones match the tutorial's actual stages, language and key concepts, not generic boilerplate
expectations.evidence: Milestones mirror the tutorial's actual 24 steps with its specific concepts: 'instruction decoder (opcode, rs1/rs2/rd, funct3/funct7, 5 immediate formats)', 'register bank + 3-state FSM (FETCH_INSTR, FETCH_REGS, EXECUTE)', 'JAL/JALR + nextPC', 'branches (6 variants + takeBranch)', '33-bit subtract, EQ/LT/LTU', 'LW/LB/LBU/LH/LHU', 'SW/SB/SH + wmask', 'IO page bit 22, 1-hot', 'Mandelbrot (fixed point, mulsi3)', 'MappedSPIFlash + mem_rbusy', 'spiflash0.ld, iceprog', 'riscv64-elf-gcc', '$readmemh', 'sieve.c'; references real repo files clockworks.v, riscv_assembly.v, bench_iverilog.v, run.sh.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); asks the learner to install if needed
expectations.evidence: Agent ran no installer itself (brew install appears only as learner instructions), but shell command 'mkdir -p /tmp/femtorv && curl -sL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/.../README.md" -o /tmp/femtorv/README.md' followed by 'cp -r /tmp/femtorv .../.tutorial-ref' wrote files to /tmp, outside the project dir.
